inputs.locator: Decision feature: DAILY_POSITIVE_RETURN_QUOTE_VOLUME_SHARE_TO_PRIOR_20D_MEDIAN. For exactly 24 H1 bars wholly inside the latest complete UTC day, estimate quote volume as close times base volume, sum it when close is strictly above open, divide by total estimated quote volume, then divide by the median of exactly the prior 20 complete-day shares. Admit only at or above the frozen threshold. Individual zero-volume hours are retained; non-positive daily total fails closed. Aggressor-side, order-book, cross-venue, later-bar, alternate candle-rule, formula, lookback or threshold inference is forbidden.

Frozen variants and accounting: lower neighbor 0.8, primary 1.0 and upper neighbor 1.2; Design 2019-2022, historical Validation 2023-2024 and annual folds 2020-2024. Parent and every variant use 250 USDT initial equity, effective 240 USDT whole-lot capacity, eight 30-USDT lots, 0.10 percent fee each side, 0.05 percent adverse slippage each side, next-open fills, unchanged DRA seven-day cooldown and profit-only exits.

Frozen gate set: require exact corpus and parent parity; primary Design and Validation total PnL strictly higher; Validation realized and unrealized non-worse; Validation drawdown delta at most +0.25pp; median and P90 holding non-worse; at least four Validation interventions; at least 3/5 annual total-PnL wins and 4/5 annual drawdown non-worse; positive annual delta concentration at most 60 percent; both neighbors improve Validation total PnL, stay within drawdown tolerance and have adequate support. Every gate must pass.

objective: Evaluate exactly one frozen directional-volume-participation DRA V1 entry-admission mechanism on the sealed pre-2025 H1 corpus. Compare the unchanged equal-capital parent with primary 1.0 and frozen 0.8/1.2 neighbors. Retain one prior for a separately frozen hypothesis only if Design, Validation, annual breadth, concentration, drawdown, holding, underwater duration, utilization, realized/unrealized PnL and terminal inventory pass the unchanged declarative gate set; otherwise close the family without tuning. This is an H1 directional participation proxy, not true order flow, clean OOS, a candidate, a runtime filter or Trading authorization.
stop_conditions: Before corpus or outcome access, validate the exact task, dispatch, intent and strategy path; re-hash every non-null input and require a clean branch whose HEAD equals origin. Any mismatch is DRA_DIRECTIONAL_VOLUME_PARTICIPATION_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT.
Read only the listed files, task messages and exact sealed TSV. Do not inspect another research artifact, current server state, post-2024 bar, forward outcome or OOS.
Require corpus SHA-256 e436a5a2b093365886464dd3e471cc5cd55c54bd2c06ceaa898ac218c45436dd, exactly 52,608 finite contiguous H1 OHLCV rows through 2025-01-01. Do not repair a failure.
Require the committed declarative, equal-capital and base DRA runners at frozen task hashes. Import and run them without editing, monkey-patching, wrapping or changing economics.

Use exactly the unchanged parent and three frozen directional-volume variants 0.8, 1.0 and 1.2. Do not run another threshold, relation, lookback, candle rule, weighting, formula or order-flow estimate.

For each complete UTC day use only its 24 H1 bars; weight each by close times base volume, count the weight only when close is above open, divide by total weight and then by the prior-20-day median. Individual zero-volume hours remain; non-positive daily total fails closed.
Keep Design 2019-2022, historical Validation 2023-2024 and folds 2020-2024 fixed. Historical Validation is development evidence, not clean OOS.

Return DRA_DIRECTIONAL_VOLUME_PARTICIPATION_PRIOR_RETAIN only if every frozen primary and neighbor gate passes; otherwise valid paired evidence returns DRA_DIRECTIONAL_VOLUME_PARTICIPATION_BRANCH_CLOSE without tuning.

Return DRA_DIRECTIONAL_VOLUME_PARTICIPATION_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT for any input, data, parity, arithmetic, accounting or required-field failure. Do not partially classify a window or request permission.
A retained prior permits at most one separately frozen hypothesis. It is not alpha, a candidate, OOS, true order flow, a runtime filter, deployment or Trading authorization.

Stop without permission if an action requires an unlisted file, dependency, network, server call, post-2024 evidence, outcome-dependent change, OOS, candidate action or Trading action. Preserve exact missing proof.
